newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists see more gains for AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists see more gains for AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists remain bullish on the prospects of the AEX share index, but note that the momentum of the recent rise has faded somewhat.
The AEX index ended at 980.74 points on Friday, August 1, 8.29 points below the previous Friday. In the week before that the index had gained 47.24 points.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ABN AMRO - The trend is still up but trend intensity slows down. Short term traders tighten their stops to first support at 975.00. They increase positions with a break of the previous top at 996.50. Longer term investors do not adjust their portfolios. Only a break below 928.50 will disturb the longer trend.

ING BARINGS - AEX is pausing within the uptrend, as prices are hovering around the flattening nine-day moving average at 977. Momentum is cooling down and has already made its first lower top, signalling a possible correction phase ahead.

Money flow remains solid as it keeps rising and making new highs, indicating buyers are still the majority. A decreasing number of stocks (45) reached new 12-month highs, confirming an increasing number of individual stocks seem to consolidate. And our 12-day average of the call/put ratio is falling, however still in a danger zone.

Despite these slightly weakening technicals, we remain bullish as horizontal support 973 stays intact. A close below 973 would violate the short term uptrend, triggering a minor sell signal towards the 930-920 support area, with initial support around 956-953. A move above the horizontal 996 barrier confirms the uptrend, indicating a likely start of a new acceleration phase within the current longer-term bull market.

MEES PIERSON - The coming week will be very exciting again, with a lot of important companies releasing first half and second quarter results. Investors have high expectations and up till now figures were much better, so for the coming week we advise investors to look at the companies that still have to publish their figures. These companies will in general have a better performance than our index. For the index as a whole, we stay neutral due to the lower bond market and a dollar topping out. Short term trend: neutral; long term trend: up.

RABO SECURITIES - AEX share index still in the middle of a small consolidation pattern. As long as the index keeps hovering between 957 and 995, we will maintain our short term neutral recommendation. If the support at 957 is crossed, the index could slip to 928. If the index breaks 995 resistance level, the market will get a breather to prolong its long term uptrend.
